name: Pan India Corporation Limited
about: Pan India Corporation Limited invests in, buys, sells, transfers, hypothecates, deals in, and disposes shares, stocks, debentures, debenture stocks, securities of government and local authority, bonds, certificates, and immovable or movable properties in India. The company also acquires and leases industrial, office plant, equipment, and machinery, as well as vehicles, buildings, and real estate properties for manufacturing processes. In addition, it is involved in transportation, trading, and other commercial services activities. The company was formerly known as SRG Infotec Ltd. Pan India Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.
